input.text:
Drake has four songs on the US Spotify top 25 in the week of Oct 8, 2026, adding up to 19.2M streams, and three of them debuted in the top 13. 📈

The new songs arrived Oct 2 on the HABIBTI (FOMO) edition: "Solar Eclipse" with Don Toliver debuted at #8 (5.8M US streams), "Quebec" at #11 (4.9M) and "Cold Shoulder" with Don Toliver and Yebba at #13 (4.7M). "Janice STFU" is still at #25 (3.8M) after 21 weeks.

"Solar Eclipse" interpolates Ella Langley's "Choosin' Texas" (the #3 song on the same chart with 8.0M streams) and is reported at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100, Don Toliver's highest-charting song. Drake took 8.9% of all streams on the US top 50 (19.2M of 216.5M) and has 94.9M monthly listeners on Spotify.

Which Drake song is your #1 from this drop? 👇

Data: kworb.net Spotify US weekly chart (week of Oct 8, 2026), Spotify monthly listeners (Oct 15, 2026), Whiskey Riff, Hot New Hip Hop
